title: Strive To Be Great  The Kingdom Is Yours‼️👀
cleanTitle: Strive To Be Great The Kingdom Is Yours‼️👀
segments: If we not striving to be great, there's
nothing else out here for us.
>> Zephaniah chapter 3:19, "Behold, at that
time I will undo all that afflict thee,
and I will save her that halted, and
gather her that was driven out. I will
give them praise and fame in every land
where they have been put to shame."
>> "I will give them praise and fame in
every land where they have been put to
shame." That's what we should be for
right there. A person that has a mindset
of thinking he's less than nothing, he
ain't going to get this.
>> Verse 20, "At that time will I bring you
again, even in the time that I gather
you. For I will make you a name and a
praise among all people of the earth."
>> Because we deserve that. If we keep the
laws and the faith of Christ, that's
what we deserve right there. That's what
the Lord is going to give us. Scripture
says, "Eyes have not seen, ears have not
heard." We don't know what the Lord got
in store for us, man. We got to shoot
for the stars. It's things that the Lord
has given us in this sense that's really
good to us. But imagine in the kingdom.
>> "When I turn back your captivity before
your eyes, saith the Lord."
>> Cuz he's going to do it. The Lord is
going to change us, y'all. He going to
change us, and we going to get that. But
we have to work for it.
